trustedSources.hashLaw: sha256(concat(for each entry in trustedSources.sources order: utf8(role) + 0x00 + utf8(repo-relative posix path) + 0x00 + utf8(per-source sha256 hex) + 0x00))
trustedSources.order: sources listed in lexically ascending role + 0x00 + path (JS string order); the digest consumes them in exactly that order, insertion order never affects it

admissionDocument.reason: The runner public World/HTTP surface exposes no plane TrustedSources/admission source document or digest. authoritative-tool-sources.v1.json is census inventory, not the plane admission document; it cannot substitute.

trustedSources.recompute: recomputeTrustedSources(record, repoRoot): family sha256 re-hashed from the tracked bytes; the union digest re-derived from the entry list; profile/oracle entries are covered by their own cells (launched-profile re-hash / recomputeWorldOracle)

worldOracle.order: sources listed in lexically ascending repo-relative posix path (JS string order); the digest consumes them in exactly that order
worldOracle.hashLaw: sha256(concat(for each source in worldOracle.sources order: utf8(repo-relative posix path) + 0x00 + raw file bytes + 0x00))

bindings.oracleCoverage: suite entry plus every literal import/re-export/dynamic-import/read edge reachable inside the repo root (product files included), byte copies retained base64 in the cited artifact under sha256(concat(for each source in worldOracle.sources order: utf8(repo-relative posix path) + 0x00 + raw file bytes + 0x00)); launcher/registry helpers listed in excludedHelpers define no expected answers; bare specifiers in externalSpecifiers stay host-bound; paths resolving outside the repo root in unfollowedPaths; a literal read whose path is computed at runtime is disclosed in unresolvedLiteralReads (runtime input, literalReadsComplete=false); an unresolvable dynamic import or an unreadable closure file sets complete=false
bindings.profileDisclosure: World profiles disable ONLY the two deepseekLlmApiExtensions metadata contributors (session-log-deepseek, plugin-package-inventory-deepseek) through their own public config.enabled flag — s1-h0-m1 noext precedent; on fresh unauthenticated homes they fail every model request with REQUEST_EXTENSION before dispatch (measured u5dbg run; reported as a product observation, not hidden). Tools, Guard, dispatch, registry rows otherwise untouched.

profileArtifacts.coverage: exact materialized web profile patch bytes, including comments and final newline; hashed BEFORE spawn and re-hashed from the launched file AFTER it (composedProfileDigestMismatch); not a flattened upstream base bundle

readImageDescriptions: Read one governed image file inside this member's admitted file root and attach it to the conversation. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused. The file is durably committed to
cases.law: PASS needs the imgov lane model request to carry exactly one tool named read_image, its description to be the governed row text (fs-family/src/image-row.mjs: "Read one governed image file inside this member's admitted file root…", never the native "Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file…"), AND a mount-time placement line naming read_image. A second row or the native description is a FAIL naming the live shape.
cases.rcaSummary: no exactly-one governed read_image row on the live model surface: read the imgov lane request (body.tools[]) against the mount lines in the host log (grep placement-feed / "a5-plane: placed"); a native-shape row means the governed mount never took the name, two rows means a placement conflict that did not fail closed, and no line at all means the fs family never mounted in this session.

cases.law: PASS needs ALL of, for the SAME call: a durable control-request-recorded row (toolName=read_image) answered allow through team.resolveControl v4, the kernel audit naming a minted/approved grant, and exactly ONE `governed-image RAN` line. Zero witnesses is FAIL, never a softening; a pre-gate refusal (IMAGE_MODEL_NOT_CAPABLE / attachment-service-unmounted) is disclosed verbatim here.
cases.rcaSummary: the allow→grant→RAN chain never closed: read the ledger face (control-request-recorded / control-decision-recorded / control-allow-consumed) and the host log governed-image lines; a pre-gate code names the exact gate that stopped it.

cases.law: PASS needs: exactly one object under <DSH_HOME>/attachments/v1/objects whose file name IS the sha256 of its own bytes (the store law), and that same sha present in what the model received (attachmentId sha256:<hex> or the inline image part the harness resolved). Zero or two objects is a FAIL naming the census.
cases.rcaSummary: the store census or the sha identity failed: re-list <DSH_HOME>/attachments/v1/objects, sha256sum the object, and compare with the attachmentId/image part in the mock transcript; two objects means a double commit, zero means the commit never happened despite RAN.

cases.law: PASS needs the tool_result the model received for the RAN call to carry BOTH the envelope text block (`<path>…</path>`, `<type>image</type>`, `<content>`) and an image block (the family renders {type:image, attachment}; the harness may project it to an image content part — either shape is recorded, the absence of either is FAIL).
cases.rcaSummary: the two-block render never reached the model: read the mock request whose tool_result names read_image; a text-only result means the attachment block was dropped, an envelope-less result means the row render changed.

cases.law: PASS needs: the second durable read_image row answered deny over the public seam, a typed refusal visible on a live arm — the family executor naming code=APPROVAL_DENIED OR the member transcript carrying the durable approval refusal text (kernel admission refuses before the executor runs: RCA-7 erratum, bw8 record denialArm=kernel-admission) — and a store census that never exceeds the ONE object R1 committed: zero new objects, zero new files in the governed workspace.
cases.rcaSummary: the deny arm produced a side effect or no typed refusal: compare the store/workspace census before/after the second call with the governed-image pa-refused line; a store object appearing after a deny is a product blocker.

cases.law: PASS needs the store's OWN law word on the third call (observe line `governed-image store-law-refused code=IMAGE_TOO_MANY_PIXELS|IMAGE_DIMENSION_TOO_LARGE|IMAGE_TOO_LARGE`) with the RAN count still 1 and the object census still 1 — a deterministic law refusal must commit nothing. A pre-gate byte cap instead of the store law is disclosed here, not accepted silently.
cases.rcaSummary: the over-pixel PNG either committed (product blocker), never reached the store law (check the pre-gate codes and the byte cap), or the call never ran (lane script). The planted PNG is 8192x7817 = 64,036,864 px against the pinned 64,000,000 limit.

cases.law: PASS needs ALL of: the durable ask row allowed over team.resolveControl v4, the $events waterfall settled over POST /api/$events/result, `governed-ask RAN`, and the human answer label present in the tool_result the model saw.
cases.rcaSummary: the public answering face never closed the loop: read the answerer wire facts (ready frame, waterfall frames, POST result status) and the governed-ask lines; a port-failure code names the family gate that stopped it.

cases.law: L2 as-is: assertLiveRoot only runs when the request carries an Agent; the family port binding passes none, so the open ask never reaches the live-root law. Recorded, never retried, NOT_REACHED-safe by lane order.
